description: Baldwin Borough Sanitary Sewer Infrastructure is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Baldwin Borough. Data on where the sanitary sewer lines and manholes are located in the Borough. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Baldwin Borough. Its tags are Baldwin Borough, manhole, pipe, poop, sanitary. It offers 2 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2023-05-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Attribution License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
